title: distance per player: stitching our track fragments into players (fixed camera, no identification), first test on ordinary play
owner request: 2026-11-17: distance per player is needed; 'the camera is fixed so we should be able to follow a player all the time even if he is not formally identified'; bar within 5%
facts before: on the 47 windows (3 min) a true player is matched to our detections 63% of the time (median) and split over 6 of our tracks (p90 10); his longest track covers 30% of the window; our tracks last 27.5 s (median)
units: the 47 ordinary-play windows (138 min, 10 matches), our player detections and tracks as in metric_v3s_link (pitch metres, kit teams); truth = the GT people (player_id, centre origin, every frame)
fragments: our tracks with >= 5 detections; team = majority of their kit labels (team_A, team_B, other); positions smoothed by a centred 1-s mean
stitching (S): one global assignment (Hungarian) of fragment ends to fragment starts of the same team class: gap g in [-0.4, 10] s; predicted point = end point + end velocity (last 1 s) x min(max(g, 0), 1 s); allowed if the start lies within 2 m + 7 m/s x max(g, 0) of it; cost = distance / (2 + 7 max(g, 0)) + 0.05 g; a fragment end may stay unlinked at cost 1.0; links chained into trajectories (overlapping frames: the earlier fragment's dropped)

baselines.O (oracle identity): every detection matched to the player (Hungarian <= 2 m, each frame used) joined into one path: the ceiling of our detections with a perfect identity

measures (per player-window, truth playe.continuity: share of the player's window covered by his dominant trajectory (the one matched to him most), U vs S
measures (per player-window, truth playe.pieces: number of trajectories matched to him (>= 2 matched samples), U vs S
measures (per player-window, truth playe.swaps: share of a dominant trajectory's matched samples that belong to another player (identity mixing), S
measures (per player-window, truth playe.distance on the dominant trajectory: path length (gaps interpolated linearly, centred 1-s mean, sampled every 1 s) vs the truth player's over the same span: median absolute relative error and share within 5%, U vs S
measures (per player-window, truth playe.distance, oracle: O's path over the whole window vs the truth's: median abs relative error, share within 5%

reading.stitching works on 3 min: S's continuity median >= 0.80 and its distance within 5% on >= 70% of player-windows
reading.detections limit: O itself misses 5% on most players: identity is not the only limit
reading.otherwise: reported; what breaks (gaps, crowds, swaps) read from the fragments

what this cannot show: a whole match (needs whole-match tracking on the GPU, ~7 h per match); the owner's camera
